requirements.id: settings.reference.What runs under allowManagedHooksOnly.Everything else is blocked
requirements.note: Added that a skill's frontmatter hooks run only for a managed-directory skill or a force-enabled plugin's skill (J7.3, §7.1.4 item 5). Evidence: settings-reference.md, 'What runs under allowManagedHooksOnly' (lists what runs); hooks.md, 'Limits on skill hooks' (managed-directory skill counted as the organization's).

The files kept beside remote-settings.json are the client's own, named by it; a library protects the ones its host names (J13.35). Evidence: permission-modes.md, 'Protected paths', names them by role only; claude-directory.md names only remote-settings.json.
In a linked worktree, hooks/ and config inside the common .git stay write-denied (docs: sandboxing.md | Filesystem isolation).

Stated the over-500 message `command must not be longer than the install consent UI can display` beside the ASCII one, both errors at plugins.<i>.source.command. Oracle 2.1.325: 500 chars passes, 501 draws it, 501 with a four-space run draws both (J15.8).
Added `Invalid URL` for a url that does not parse, reported beside the https message. Oracle 2.1.325: `not a url` drew both, `http://` only the https message (J15.8).

Listed the cases that stay the bare `plugins.<i>.source: Invalid input`: no source key, unknown type, each type's required field missing or mistyped, npm package with `..`. Oracle 2.1.325, one case each (J15.8).

requirements.id: dependencies.guide.Test a plugin and its dependency locally.You disabled the local copy
requirements.note: The disabled-dependency error names the resolved id (`q2@m` when the dependent's marketplace is implied; bare `q2` for a --plugin-dir dependent). Oracle 2.1.325, private config dir, installed p@m with dependency q2 and q2@m disabled (J16.24).
Entry shapes fixed: errors/warnings objects, notes plain strings, gatingHooks {module, pattern, hook, hasCatch}. Oracle 2.1.325 on a mod with two tool.call hooks (J17.15).

Path variables in a monitor command are pasted as paths and never exported, referenced or not; an environment-reference mode is only an opt-in option (J9.17). Evidence: plugins/manifest-reference.md, 'Where each variable resolves' (Not exported) and 'Quoting and path separators'.

judgments.note: States the order exactly: settings files in §12.3 precedence, highest first (managed, --settings, local, project, user), then plugins in §16 load order, then frontmatter and session-added hooks as they register; gates remove without reordering.

New: under allowManagedHooksOnly, skill frontmatter hooks run only for managed-directory skills and force-enabled plugins' skills; bundled and all other skills' are blocked. No oracle (needs a live session under managed settings).

§9.1.3 rows for an empty and a missing command restated from oracle 2.1.325 (`Too small: expected string to have >=1 characters` at lspServers.go.command; `lspServers: Invalid input`); the 2.1.321 corpus has no lspServers command case.
New: monitor path variables pasted, not exported; an env-reference mode only as an opt-in.
New: MultiEdit is not a known tool; bare and path deny rules draw `matches no tool`, the path form also the file-permission warning. Oracle 2.1.325 -p stderr.
New: the files beside remote-settings.json are the client's own; a library protects the host-named ones, no guessed names.
Adds the over-500 message, `Invalid URL` and the bare `Invalid input` cases, oracle 2.1.325.
Disabled dependency named by its resolved id (q2@m with an implied marketplace; bare name only when none), errorDetails dependency the same; oracle 2.1.325 installed case.
notes are plain strings; gatingHooks entries are {module, pattern, hook, hasCatch}; oracle 2.1.325.
